source_title: Jennifer Lawrence Finally Confirms ‘Hunger Games’ Return, Reunites With Two Former Co-Stars
source_excerpt:
Jennifer Lawrence is finally confirming she’s returning to The Hunger Games franchise.
The actress discussed being back as Katniss Everdeen in the upcoming Sunrise on the Reaping , which opens next month. Lawrence also confirmed she reunited with her former Hunger Games co-stars Josh Hutcherson and Woody Harrelson, whose participation has also long been speculated.
Lawrence was asked by Call Her Daddy host Alex Cooper about returning to the franchise, and the actress replied, “Unbelievable. It was so crazy because it was the same crew. It was the same camera guys, the same AD, who I’ve worked with a million times … and Josh and Woody and it was so emotional. Like Josh and I like didn’t walk to the bathroom without our arms around each other. It was so beautiful.” Related Stories News Connor Wood Reveals What Happened on 8th Avenue With Jennifer Lawrence in New Smoothie King Collab: "Missed My Moment" (Exclusive) Movies Jennifer Lawrence Cites 'Hunger Games' While Encouraging Fans to Vote: "Don't Forget Who Burns With Us"

She also added that Harrelson climbed through her hotel window.
“And Woody obviously came through the window of my hotel room uninvited cause it would not be the same. It wouldn’t be the same if he listened to boundaries and used a door.”
The actress also revealed that she gave herself a pixie cut back in 2013 to protest The Hunger Games producers initially refusing to give her a wig for Mockingjay after the actress had grown frustrated with having to dye her hair brown.
“I was in The Hunger Games and I really wanted to use a wig cuz I was tired of dying my hair brown and they were refusing to give me a wig,” she said. “And so I had my first tiny little protest of giving myself the worst haircut anyone has ever seen in their life — which was the pixie, famously.”
In Sunrise on the Reaping is a prequel set 24 years before the original film, following 16-year-old Haymitch Abernathy as he competes in the 50th Hunger Games, also known as the Second Quarter Quell, in which twice as many tributes are forced to fight to the death. Joseph Zada plays young Haymitch and Ralph Fiennes is President Snow. The legacy characters are expected to appear in flashforwards or a framing device. The film opens Nov. 20.

## फ्रैंचाइज़ में वापसी
जेनिफर लॉरेंस ने आगामी प्रीक्वल फिल्म *सनराइज ऑन द रीपिंग* के लिए *द हंगर गेम्स* फ्रैंचाइज़ में अपनी वापसी की पुष्टि की है। अभिनेत्री ने बताया कि सेट पर वापस लौटना उनके लिए एक भावुक अनुभव था। उन्होंने साझा किया कि पुराने क्रू मेंबर्स और अपने पूर्व सह-कलाकारों जोश हचरसन और वुडी हैरलसन के साथ फिर से काम करना उनके लिए "अविश्वसनीय" था।

## फिल्म की जानकारी
*सनराइज ऑन द रीपिंग* 20 नवंबर को सिनेमाघरों में रिलीज होने के लिए निर्धारित है। यह फिल्म मूल फिल्मों से 24 साल पहले की कहानी है, जो 50वें हंगर गेम्स (जिसे सेकंड क्वार्टर क्वेल के रूप में भी जाना जाता है) पर केंद्रित है। फिल्म में जोसेफ ज़ेडा युवा हेमिच एबरनेथी की भूमिका निभा रहे हैं और राल्फ फिएन्स राष्ट्रपति स्नो के किरदार में नजर आएंगे। उम्मीद है कि जेनिफर लॉरेंस जैसे लीगेसी किरदार फ्लैशफॉरवर्ड या किसी फ्रेमिंग डिवाइस के माध्यम से दिखाई देंगे।

## पुरानी यादें
फ्रैंचाइज़ के साथ अपने इतिहास को याद करते हुए, लॉरेंस ने 2013 में अपने बाल कटवाने के फैसले के बारे में भी बताया। उन्होंने कहा कि यह उन निर्माताओं के खिलाफ एक छोटा सा विरोध था, जिन्होंने *मॉकिंगजे* के लिए उन्हें विग देने से इनकार कर दिया था, जबकि वह अपने बालों को ब्राउन कलर करने से थक चुकी थीं।

*   **रिलीज की तारीख:** 20 नवंबर
*   **मुख्य कलाकार:** जोसेफ ज़ेडा (हेमिच), राल्फ फिएन्स (राष्ट्रपति स्नो)
*   **विषय:** फिल्म 50वें हंगर गेम्स की घटनाओं को दर्शाती है।

en_body:
## Return to the Franchise
Jennifer Lawrence has confirmed her return to *The Hunger Games* universe for the upcoming prequel, *Sunrise on the Reaping*. The actress expressed that returning to the set was an emotional experience, noting that reuniting with familiar crew members and co-stars Josh Hutcherson and Woody Harrelson felt "unbelievable."

## Project Details
*Sunrise on the Reaping* is scheduled to open in theaters on November 20. The film serves as a prequel set 24 years before the events of the original movies, focusing on the 50th Hunger Games, also known as the Second Quarter Quell. While Joseph Zada portrays a young Haymitch Abernathy and Ralph Fiennes plays President Snow, legacy characters like Lawrence's Katniss Everdeen are expected to appear via a framing device or flashforwards.

## Looking Back
Reflecting on her history with the franchise, Lawrence shared a story about her 2013 decision to cut her hair into a pixie style. She noted that this was a form of personal protest against producers who initially refused to provide her with a wig for *Mockingjay*, despite her desire to stop dyeing her hair brown.

*   **Release Date:** November 20
*   **Key Cast:** Joseph Zada (Haymitch), Ralph Fiennes (President Snow)
*   **Context:** The film depicts the 50th Hunger Games.
